name: Gale Reef
description: Gale Reef: Spend seven days exploring clear water, colorful coral, and quiet beaches. The trip includes guided snorkeling, a sunset boat cruise, and a stay at Travlr Ocean Resort.

name: Dawson's Reef
description: Dawson's Reef: Discover a lively reef during five days of kayaking, swimming, and optional guided diving. Relax each evening at Travlr Coral Resort.

name: Claire's Reef
description: Claire's Reef: Enjoy six days of coral viewing, beach walks, and local seafood. Your stay at Travlr Lagoon Resort includes easy access to the reef and nearby island trails.
